notes: NEEDS RULING: «ونحن عند سعيد بن المسيب» names Sa'id as the place of hearing, not as the source named after «عن»; rule 5 could make him a link, so he is not added until ruled
«رجل، من مزينة» is a transmitter the text does not name: unnamed
«قال اليهود أتوا النبي» — the Jews in the story are subjects, not links; Abu Hurayra is the last link

fixes.reason: K6I attaches محمد بن يحيى بن حبان to the name the text writes as محمد بن يحيى بن فارس; the lexicon date 121 AH is too early for a man who heard from Abd al-Razzaq (d. 211).

evidence.quote: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى بن فارس
